verdict.rationale: Getting started takes a single documented command, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`, and skills.sh itself promises install "with a single command." A runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npm with no account, switches to non-interactive mode automatically, and lists a repo's skills before you install. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an actual `add` completing and the skill loading in an agent, and any timed or dedicated step-by-step quickstart confirming the under-five-minutes claim.
